+# Stage 1 revised physiological architecture and design review
+
+## Decision status
+
+This proposal is the scientific design gate required before equation implementation. It selects the smallest architecture that separates mechanisms needed by Stage 2 without claiming patient-level validity. The original implementation and fixtures remain archived under `validation/baseline/stage0/`.
+
+**Review disposition.** Independent analytical review initially returned REVISE. The blocking findings—head-level baroreflex reference, incomplete migration formulas, OCPE declarative divergence, and per-phenotype fixed-point coverage—are resolved in this revision. The review analytically confirmed conservation, units, healthy equilibrium, CFI curve properties, regional gravity/pump placement, minimality, and inclusion of the PEM configuration correction. Implementation is authorized only for the mechanisms and consistency corrections classified above.
+
+## Architecture decision
+
+The revised shared model contains four conservative stressed-volume compartments, three autonomic effector states, an explicit protocol-driven skeletal-muscle-pump flow, and a cerebral-perfusion-pressure-based normalized proxy. The phenomenological exertion/PEM equations are retained, while their contradictory onset/recovery configuration is corrected and revalidated explicitly.
+
+```text
+                         cardiac sympathetic ──> contractility ──> SV ──> CO
+                         vagal + cardiac sympathetic ──> HR ────────╯
+ arterial pressure ──> baroreflex
+                         vascular sympathetic ──> splanchnic arterial R
+                                                  lower-limb arterial R
+
+ CO ──> arterial volume ──> splanchnic arterial flow ──> splanchnic venous volume
+                      └──> lower-limb arterial flow ────> lower-limb venous volume
+ central venous volume <── splanchnic venous return <── splanchnic volume + gravity
+ central venous volume <── lower-limb venous return <── lower-limb volume + gravity
+                                                       + rhythmic muscle-pump flow
+                                                       / sustained-contraction R
+
+ brain-level CPP = arterial P - orthostatic heart–brain offset - central venous P
+ CPP ──> bounded autoregulation proxy ──> dynamic normalized cerebral-flow index
+```
+
+Splanchnic and lower-limb compartments are separate because human tilt studies show splanchnic filling and region-specific volume/resistance responses. No additional renal, pulmonary, interstitial, or cardiac pressure–volume compartment is introduced.
+
+## Change classification
+
+| Change | Classification | Rationale |
+|---|---|---|
+| Conserve volume across arterial, central, splanchnic, and lower-limb compartments | Necessary correction | Makes regional pooling and volume movement explicit |
+| Separate splanchnic and lower-limb venous volumes and return paths | Evidence-supported improvement | Upright splanchnic loading differs from limb pooling and LBNP |
+| Separate cardiac sympathetic, vascular sympathetic, and vagal states | Evidence-supported improvement | Prevents HR from proxying all autonomic activity |
+| Give vagal, cardiac sympathetic, and vascular sympathetic pathways distinct lags | Evidence-supported improvement | Represents fast vagal versus slower sympathetic effects without a DDE |
+| Add rhythmic muscle-pump flow based on contraction frequency, pumped volume, and venous volume | Evidence-supported improvement | Represents walking/light activity independently of metabolic exertion |
+| Increase lower-limb venous resistance during sustained contraction | Evidence-supported improvement, calibrated magnitude | Represents mechanical impediment rather than treating all activity as beneficial |
+| Use brain-level CPP and a bounded autoregulation proxy for CFI | Necessary correction to interpretation; evidence-supported structure | Systemic MAP alone is not cerebral perfusion pressure |
+| Retain reduced-order preload-dependent SV | Deliberate retention | More detailed cardiac PV mechanics are not identifiable from current data |
+| Retain stressed volumes only; no dynamic unstressed-volume reservoir | Deliberate retention | The concept is established, but regional human values and control laws are too uncertain for this scope |
+| Retain disease-specific cerebral impairment multipliers | Exploratory hypothesis | Needed for existing ME/CFS/Long COVID scenario semantics; not a direct measurement |
+| Retain PEM equations | Out of cardiovascular redesign scope | Avoids silent Stage 2 disease-mechanism changes |
+| Correct ME/CFS onset/recovery time-constant inversion | Necessary consistency correction | The calibrated scenario currently makes recovery faster than onset despite claiming prolonged recovery |
+| Align the OCPE declarative model with executable equations | Necessary consistency correction | The current package declares different HR, SV, venous-return, CFI, and PEM equations and different nominal values |
+| Use sustained rather than peak HR rise for POTS scenario criteria | Necessary validation correction | The consensus scenario criterion concerns sustained tachycardia; peak HR remains secondary |
+| Replace the hardcoded 0.78 functional-capacity normalizer and strengthen parameter bounds | Necessary software/scientific correction | Prevents silent normalization drift and rejects invalid regimes before integration |
+| Add CO₂, renal/endocrine volume regulation, nonlinear venous compliance, venous valves, pure delays, afterload, and filling-time dependence | Deferred optional refinements | Each needs additional inputs, evidence, calibration, and validation |
+
+## Revised states
+
+| State | Symbol | Unit | Definition |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| `arterial_volume` | $V_a$ | mL | Arterial stressed volume |
+| `central_venous_volume` | $V_c$ | mL | Central venous stressed volume; remains a reduced-order preload proxy |
+| `splanchnic_venous_volume` | $V_s$ | mL | Splanchnic venous stressed volume |
+| `lower_limb_venous_volume` | $V_l$ | mL | Lower-limb venous stressed volume |
+| `cardiac_sympathetic_state` | $S_c$ | 1 | Cardiac sympathetic effector state |
+| `vascular_sympathetic_state` | $S_v$ | 1 | Vascular sympathetic effector state |
+| `vagal_state` | $V$ | 1 | Vagal cardiac effector state |
+| `exertional_load` | $L$ | 1 | Existing phenomenological load |
+| `delayed_stress` | $D$ | 1 | Existing delayed stress |
+| `pem_severity` | $PEM$ | 1 | Existing normalized PEM severity |
+| `cerebral_flow_index` | $CFI$ | 1 | Normalized proxy, not direct CBF or MCA velocity |
+
+The prior `sympathetic_state` output becomes the arithmetic mean of $S_c$ and $S_v$ solely as a labeled compatibility summary. It is no longer a state or a control input.
+
+## Mathematical specification
+
+### Pressure and regional hemodynamics
+
+$$P_a=V_a/C_a,\quad P_c=V_c/C_c,\quad P_s=V_s/C_s,\quad P_l=V_l/C_l.$$
+
+$$R_{s,a}=R_{s,a0}[1+g_{s,a}(S_v-0.5)],$$
+$$R_{l,a}=R_{l,a0}[1+g_{l,a}(S_v-0.5)](1-k_{ex}e),$$
+$$R_{l,v}=R_{l,v0}(1+k_{contract}c).$$
+
+Here $e$ is normalized exertion and $c$ is explicit sustained muscle contraction. Exercise vasodilation applies only to the lower-limb arterial path, not automatically to the splanchnic bed. The regional $G_s$ and $G_l$ terms act only on venous return; arterial-side regional hydrostatic columns are not solved. $G_{head}$ corrects only the shared head-level baroreflex/cerebral pressure proxy.
+
+$$Q_{s,a}=\max[0,(P_a-P_s)/R_{s,a}],\qquad Q_{l,a}=\max[0,(P_a-P_l)/R_{l,a}],$$
+$$Q_{s,v}=\max[0,(P_s-P_c-G_su)/R_{s,v}],$$
+$$Q_{pump}=f_{pump}SV_{pump}\eta_{pump}m\frac{V_l}{V_l+K_{pump}},$$
+$$Q_{l,v}=\max[0,(P_l-P_c-G_lu)/R_{l,v}]+Q_{pump}.$$
+
+The pressure-gradient floor is an ideal-valve approximation. Pump flow is added outside that floor so a negative passive gradient cannot cancel an explicitly declared contraction-induced volume transfer; the volume-dependent pump term tends to zero as available lower-limb stressed volume is depleted.
+
+The input $m$ is rhythmic muscle activity, not exertion. Thus supine rest, inactive standing, walking, light rhythmic activity, and sustained contraction are independent protocol conditions. Pump magnitude is a computational assumption; its dependence on contraction frequency, pumped volume, effectiveness, and available venous volume is explicit.
+
+### Volume conservation and cardiac output
+
+$$\dot V_a=Q_{co}-Q_{s,a}-Q_{l,a},$$
+$$\dot V_c=Q_{s,v}+Q_{l,v}-Q_{co},$$
+$$\dot V_s=Q_{s,a}-Q_{s,v},$$
+$$\dot V_l=Q_{l,a}-Q_{l,v}.$$
+
+The four derivatives telescope exactly. Muscle pumping transfers volume from lower-limb to central venous compartments; it does not create blood.
+
+$$SV=SV_{max}\max[0.2,1+k_E(S_c-0.5)]\frac{V_c}{V_c+K_{SV}},$$
+$$Q_{co}=HR\,SV/60.$$
+
+Central venous stressed volume remains a deliberately reduced-order Frank–Starling proxy. It is not labeled ventricular end-diastolic volume.
+
+### Autonomic regulation
+
+$$P_{baro}=\max[0,P_a-G_{head}u],\qquad B=\sigma[(P_{set}-P_{baro})/\sigma_P],$$
+$$\dot S_c=(B-S_c)/\tau_{S_c},\qquad \dot S_v=(B-S_v)/\tau_{S_v},$$
+$$V_{target}=1-B,\qquad \dot V=(1-B-V)/\tau_V,$$
+$$HR=\operatorname{clip}[HR_{rest}+g_{S_c}(S_c-0.5)+g_V(0.5-V)+g_{ex}eC,30,220].$$
+
+First-order effector lags approximate distributed neural and neuroeffector dynamics. They are not pure neural transmission delays. The baroreflex senses a head-level pressure proxy rather than an uncorrected heart-level pressure; $G_{head}$ is shared with the cerebral heart–brain correction as a minimal heart-to-head hydrostatic assumption, not a claim that carotid and cerebral heights are identical. Healthy defaults start at $B=S_c=S_v=V=0.5$, so $HR_{rest}$ is the actual supine resting operating point rather than the old intercept.
+
+### Cerebral perfusion proxy
+
+$$CPP=\max[0,P_a-G_{head}u-P_c],\qquad x=CPP/CPP_{ref},$$
+$$CFI_{pressure}=\frac{x}{s_{AR}+(1-s_{AR})x},$$
+$$CFI_{target}=CFI_{pressure}\max(0,1-\beta u),$$
+$$\dot{CFI}=(CFI_{target}-CFI)/\tau_{CBF}.$$
+
+For $0<s_{AR}\leq1$, the pressure curve passes through $(1,1)$, tends to zero as CPP approaches zero, is bounded as CPP rises, and has local normalized slope $s_{AR}$ at the reference point. This is a phenomenological autoregulation curve, not a fitted cerebral vascular resistance. CPP subtracts central venous pressure as the reduced-order downstream/back-pressure proxy; intracranial pressure is not separately modeled. CO₂-dependent vasomotor effects are explicitly absent, so orthostatic hyperventilation cannot be inferred from this index.
+
+## Parameter specification and healthy operating point
+
+New values below are computational operating-point assumptions, not direct human measurements. Existing PEM values are unchanged and remain in the parameter registry.
+
+| Parameter | Value | Unit | Provenance class |
+|---|---:|---|---|
+| $C_a,C_c,C_s,C_l$ | 1.5, 140, 70, 50 | mL/mmHg | Assumed; regional structure literature-guided |
+| $R_{s,a0},R_{l,a0}$ | 2.2040816327 each | mmHg·s/mL | Derived from resting flow split and pressures |
+| $R_{s,v0},R_{l,v0}$ | 0.1224489796 each | mmHg·s/mL | Derived from resting return split and pressures |
+| $g_{s,a},g_{l,a}$ | 0.8 each | 1 | Assumed/calibrated regional gains |
+| $G_s,G_l$ | 4, 8 | mmHg | Phenomenological regional gravity offsets |
+| $V_a(0),V_c(0)$ | 150, 700 | mL | Retained assumptions |
+| $P_s(0),P_l(0)$ | 10, 10 | mmHg | Constant-pressure regional initialization |
+| $V_s(0),V_l(0)$ | 700, 500 | mL | Derived as $P_s(0)C_s$ and $P_l(0)C_l$; healthy sum preserves 2050 mL |
+| $SV_{max},K_{SV}$ | 100, 300 | mL/beat, mL | Retained assumptions |
+| $HR_{rest}$ | 70 | bpm | Resting operating-point assumption |
+| $g_{S_c},g_V$ | 20, 20 | bpm | Split of prior healthy chronotropic gain |
+| $\tau_{S_c},\tau_{S_v},\tau_V$ | 6, 10, 1 | s | Human-dynamics-guided computational choices |
+| $SV_{pump},f_{pump},\eta_{pump}$ | 20, 1, 1 | mL, 1/s, 1 | Explicit muscle-pump assumptions |
+| $K_{pump}$ | 500 | mL | Assumed volume half-saturation |
+| $k_{contract}$ | 3 | 1 | Assumed sustained-contraction impediment |
+| $CPP_{ref}$ | 95 | mmHg | Derived healthy supine $P_a-P_c$ |
+| $G_{head}$ | 20 | mmHg | Assumed full-upright heart-to-head hydrostatic correction shared by baroreflex and CPP |
+| $s_{AR}$ | 0.2 | 1 | Assumed normalized residual pressure slope |
+
+At the healthy supine initial condition: $P_a=100$ mmHg, $P_c=5$ mmHg, $P_s=P_l=10$ mmHg, $SV=70$ mL/beat, $HR=70$ bpm, and $Q_{co}=81.6667$ mL/s (4.9 L/min). Each regional arterial and venous path carries 40.8333 mL/s, so the initial state is a steady state before protocol changes. Every phenotype uses $S_c=S_v=V=0.5$ and $L=D=PEM=0$ initially. Regional initial volumes are computed from their reference pressures and compliances, then all four volumes are multiplied by `blood_volume_factor` $f$.
+
+Uniform volume scaling alone does **not** generally preserve the full supine fixed point. With $V_{c0}=700f$ mL, the resting cardiac output is
+
+$$Q_{co0}=\frac{HR_{rest}}{60}SV_{max}\frac{V_{c0}}{V_{c0}+K_{SV}}.$$
+
+For the implemented equal regional flow split, exact resting balances require
+
+$$R_{s,a0}=R_{l,a0}=\frac{2(P_{a0}-10)}{Q_{co0}},\qquad R_{s,v0}=R_{l,v0}=\frac{2(10-P_{c0})}{Q_{co0}},$$
+
+where $P_{a0}=100f$ mmHg and $P_{c0}=5f$ mmHg under the retained nominal volume/compliance assumptions. The pressure setpoint is $P_{a0}$ when a non-default volume factor is used, so the initial baroreflex target remains 0.5. The initial CFI is calculated from the same pressure curve as the dynamic target, with $u=e=0$:
+
+$$CFI_0=\frac{x_0}{s_{AR}+(1-s_{AR})x_0},\qquad x_0=\frac{\max(0,P_{a0}-P_{c0})}{CPP_{ref}}.$$
+
+Thus CFI is one at the healthy reference pressure but is 0.982906 for `pots-hypovolemic` and 0.991736 for `pots-mixed`; it is not hard-coded to one for every phenotype. The hyperadrenergic configuration also applies these flow-balance formulas with its resting HR of 71.5 bpm. All ten configurations are tested for a complete initial RHS maximum absolute component below $10^{-9}$.
+
+## Protocol specification
+
+`ProtocolSegment` gains two normalized inputs, both defaulting to zero:
+
+- `rhythmic_muscle_activity` ($m$): 0 for supine rest/inactive standing; 1 for the reference walking scenario; intermediate values only as declared light-activity scenarios.
+- `sustained_muscle_contraction` ($c$): 0 for rest/walking; positive only for an explicit sustained-contraction scenario.
+
+Metabolic exertion $e$ is not used as a proxy for either input. Protocols must declare all three independently.
+
+## Expected computational and disease-configuration consequences
+
+- State vector and persisted traces change from 8 to 11 states; metadata model version advances to 0.2.0.
+- Resting healthy outputs remain at their original operating point by construction.
+- Upright regional volumes and returns change; previous regression values are not expected to remain numerically identical.
+- Chronotropic migration is exact at the supine operating point: $HR_{rest,new}=HR_{base,old}+0.5g_{HR,old}$ and $g_{S_c}+g_V=g_{HR,old}$. The default equal split $g_{S_c}=g_V=g_{HR,old}/2$ is unidentified and must be sensitivity-tested at sympathetic fractions 0, 0.5, and 1 with total gain fixed.
+
+### Post-implementation scenario calibration and retained negative result
+
+The initial migration formula did not make every revised disease scenario meet the predeclared **sustained** final-120-second-upright HR-rise criterion. The following equal cardiac-sympathetic/vagal gains were therefore reviewed as explicit scenario calibrations, not literature measurements or newly identified physiology. Resting HR, stroke volume, cardiac output, and volume conservation were preserved by the fixed-point derivation above.
+
+| Configuration | Each chronotropic gain (bpm) | Total gain (bpm) | Sustained HR rise (bpm) |
+|---|---:|---:|---:|
+| `pots-neuropathic` | 40 | 80 | 31.63 |
+| `pots-hyperadrenergic` | 70 | 140 | 30.38 |
+| `pots-hypovolemic` | 60 | 120 | 30.66 |
+| `pots-mixed` | 50 | 100 | 32.84 |
+| `long-covid-autonomic` | 50 | 100 | 31.14 |
+
+Threshold agreement is calibration overlap, not independent validation. Peak HR rise remains reported separately. The fixed-total chronotropic-split analysis changes peak but not sustained HR rise in the neuropathic scenario, demonstrating why the split remains unidentified.
+
+The healthy early-CO soft-anchor check remains a **negative result**: the early reduction is approximately **5.64%**, below the broad 10–30% literature-derived plausibility band. Caudal stressed-volume accumulation is approximately **336.55 mL**, inside the broad 300–900 mL soft band. Neither band is a hard fitted target. The CO miss is retained as a warning and a structural limitation rather than tuned away or converted into a pass.
+
+### Migration details
+
+- Each old gravity override $G_{old}$ maps to $G_s=G_{old}/2$ and $G_l=G_{old}$; this includes healthy 8→(4,8), hEDS/ME/CFS 9→(4.5,9), POTS 10→(5,10), and Long COVID autonomic 11→(5.5,11).
+- Each old vascular gain maps to both regional arterial gains unless regional impairment is explicitly declared. `blood_volume_factor` scales all four initial volumes. The exploratory cerebral multiplier $\beta$ is unchanged and multiplies the new CPP-based target.
+- Existing `peripheral_venous_compliance` scenarios migrate to `lower_limb_venous_compliance` using $C_{l,new}=C_{p,old}(50/120)$; hEDS 140 therefore becomes 58.3333 mL/mmHg. Initialization holds supine $P_l=10$ mmHg, so $V_l(0)$ changes with compliance and total stressed volume is intentionally not volume-matched to healthy. This is an exploratory constant-pressure compliance scenario, not an hEDS blood-volume claim, and remains M2.
+- No disease-specific conditional branches are added to shared equations. Disease mechanisms enter only through registered parameters and protocol inputs.
+- More states and discontinuous max/clip boundaries increase computational cost modestly and require renewed convergence, bounds, and regime-failure testing.
+
+## Validation strategy
+
+1. Preserve the original fixture unchanged in `validation/baseline/stage0/`; generate a reviewed Stage 1 fixture with a scientific change record.
+2. Test exact RHS telescoping and integrated conservation for all four volumes, including walking and sustained contraction.
+3. Test the supine fixed point for **every phenotype**, plus dimensional consistency, parameter bounds, state bounds, non-finite failures, step-size/tolerance convergence, and flow boundary behavior.
+4. Test initial upright venous-return reduction, splanchnic/lower-limb pooling, compensatory HR and sympathetic responses, and supine recovery. Report early CO reduction against a broad 10–30% soft plausibility band and caudal stressed-volume accumulation against a broad 300–900 mL soft band around the heterogeneous 500–800 mL literature synthesis; these are anchors, not fitted patient targets.
+5. Compare inactive standing, walking, light activity, and sustained contraction at matched inputs. Verify that pumping transfers rather than creates volume and that rhythmic activity differs from metabolic exertion.
+6. Independently perturb cardiac sympathetic, vascular sympathetic, and vagal gains/time constants to demonstrate non-conflation.
+7. Verify $CO=HR\cdot SV/60$, steady-state $CO=Q_{s,v}+Q_{l,v}$, pressure–flow consistency, CPP calculation, bounded CFI, and recovery.
+8. Rewrite `ocpe/packages/disease-models/models.yaml` to cover all 11 states, regional flows, three autonomic lags, both muscle inputs, CPP/CFI, PEM dynamics, current nominal values, and units; add an executable/declarative consistency test. Re-run every disease scenario, sensitivity grid, strict traceability audit, and OCPE structural validation. Retain failed physiological regimes in reports.
+9. Include regional compliances, regional gains, gravity offsets, pump parameters, $s_{AR}$, autonomic lags, and the arbitrary chronotropic split in deterministic sensitivity analyses. These values are not individually identifiable from current evidence.
+
+## Known limitations and rejection criteria
+
+The model remains a beat-averaged research approximation with linear compliances, nonnegative clipped flows, phenomenological gravity offsets, no pulmonary/interstitial compartments, no CO₂ input, no venous-valve state, no pure neural delays, and no patient identification. Regional parameter magnitudes are not direct measurements. A converged conserved solution that produces negative volumes, non-finite outputs, cerebral proxy outside its declared bounds, or an intended healthy/phenotype scenario outside its predeclared physiological range is a failed result, not a successful calibration.

+## Stage 1 architecture revision
+
+After the initial migration, the reviewed Stage 1 design gate (`docs/stage1/revised-physiological-architecture.md`, supported by `docs/stage1/literature-and-evidence-matrix.md` and the preserved `docs/stage1/baseline-scientific-report.md`) replaced the three-compartment, single-sympathetic-state core with the current four-compartment, eleven-state model (separate splanchnic and lower-limb venous compartments; cardiac-sympathetic, vascular-sympathetic, and vagal effector states; an explicit rhythmic muscle pump; an independent sustained-contraction impediment; and a cerebral-perfusion-pressure-based flow index). The validation consequences are:
+
+- Conservation tests now cover all four volumes, including muscle-pump transfer, at both the RHS-telescoping and integrated-drift levels.
+- Every one of the ten registered configurations is tested as an exact supine fixed point (maximum absolute RHS component below 1e-9); uniform volume scaling alone does not preserve the fixed point, so per-phenotype resistance and setpoint derivations are required and tested.
+- The orthostatic scenario criterion is the sustained final-120-second-upright HR rise; the peak rise is a separate secondary metric.
+- Sensitivity exports now comprise 42 local, 18 grid, and 3 fixed-total chronotropic-split scenarios; no scenario in the current grids ends below the 70 mmHg MAP screening threshold, while the pre-revision below-70-mmHg hEDS failures remain preserved as historical results under `validation/baseline/stage0/`.
+- The Stage 0 fixture, report, and regression values are preserved unchanged as the historical baseline; they are comparators, not evidence for the revised model.
+
 ## Compatibility deviations
 
 - The former solver API (`Hc`, `pau`, carotid pressure, beat peaks) is not preserved because the new model has different states and beat-averaged outputs. Scientific metrics are preserved where meaningful; a source-level drop-in API is not claimed.
 - Legacy fixed windows are replaced by protocol-relative windows.
-- The new HR-rise metric uses upright peak during the declared comparison window; sustained versus transient response must be reported distinctly in future clinical benchmarking.
+- The original migration used the upright peak during the declared comparison window. The Stage 1 revision corrects this: the scenario criterion is now the **sustained** HR rise—the mean over the final 120 s of the upright window minus the supine baseline—and the peak first-300-s rise is retained as a separately reported secondary metric. This aligns the executable check with the consensus sustained-tachycardia criterion rather than deferring the distinction to future work.
 - OCPE upstream remains semantic infrastructure. SciPy integration in this repository is an explicit deviation forced by the upstream 0.1 scope, not a duplicated OCPE engine.
 - No legacy synthetic telemetry or wearable agreement dataset is imported. This avoids unlicensed/provenance-poor fixture reuse and respects the exclusion of synthetic wearable dataset generation.

+    study_type: Computational model validated against human tilt data
+    measured_variables:
+    - venous pooling time course
+    - orthostatic cardiovascular responses
+    relevant_findings: Gravitational pooling develops over a finite time course, supporting conservative
+      compartment dynamics rather than instantaneous volume reassignment.
+    limitations: Lung-volume dynamics remain outside this revision; no unique pooling time constant per
+      person or posture.
+    diseases:
+    - shared

 # Changelog — ocpe:disease-models
 
+## 0.2.0
+
+- Replaced the legacy three-compartment declaration with the 11-state shared
+  physiology architecture: four stressed-volume compartments, differentiated
+  autonomic states, regional muscle-pump and sustained-contraction inputs,
+  head-level cerebral perfusion, and the phenomenological PEM cascade.
+- Added executable bindings for every state, parameter, protocol input and
+  declared output. The model CURIE is now
+  `ocpe:disease-models/shared-physiology`; the previous CURIE remains a legacy
+  alias for archived observations.
+

     assumptions:
-      - Lumped compliant compartments with linear pressure-volume relations.
-      - Total blood volume is conserved (closed circulation, no transcapillary exchange).
-      - The heart is modelled as a prescribed flow source Q_h = HR * SV.
-      - Sympathetic activation is a normalized scalar driven by the baroreflex only.
-      - Pressures are stressed-volume pressures referenced to zero unstressed volume.
+      - Four lumped compliant compartments (arterial, central venous, splanchnic venous, lower-limb venous) with linear stressed pressure-volume relations and zero unstressed volume.
+      - Total stressed blood volume is conserved (closed circulation; the volume-balance derivatives telescope exactly, and the muscle pump redistributes volume without creating blood).
+      - The heart is a prescribed flow source Q_h = HR * SV with preload-dependent, saturating stroke volume and sympathetic contractility modulation.
+      - Regional flows are rectified (unidirectional) Ohm-law flows driven by compartment pressure differences and upright hydrostatic offsets.
+      - "The baroreflex senses head-level arterial pressure and drives three differentiated first-order autonomic states: cardiac sympathetic, vascular sympathetic and vagal."
+      - Protocol inputs (upright fraction, exertion, rhythmic and sustained muscle activity) are piecewise-constant scalars normalized to [0, 1].
+      - The exertional-load/delayed-stress/PEM cascade is an explicitly phenomenological exertion-delay-recovery approximation, not a claim that the cellular cause of PEM is known.

+def chronotropic_split_grid(root: Path | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Vary the unidentified vagal/cardiac-sympathetic gain split at fixed total."""
+    root = root or repository_root()
+    phenotype_id = "pots-neuropathic"
+    patient = compose_phenotypes([phenotype_id], root=root)
+    total = (
+        patient.parameters.heart_rate_cardiac_sympathetic_gain
+        + patient.parameters.heart_rate_vagal_gain
+    )
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for fraction in (0.0, 0.5, 1.0):
+        overrides = {
+            "heart_rate_cardiac_sympathetic_gain": total * fraction,
+            "heart_rate_vagal_gain": total * (1.0 - fraction),
+        }
+        row, _ = _run(phenotype_id, "head-up-tilt", overrides, root)
+        row.update(
+            {
+                "analysis": "chronotropic_split",
+                "cardiac_sympathetic_fraction": fraction,
+                "total_chronotropic_gain": total,
+                "identifiability": "split is not identified by the current evidence",
+            }
+        )
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows

+"""VAL-MATH-EQUILIBRIUM: configured supine fixed points and flow identities."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+from ocpe_disease_models.config import compose_phenotypes, load_protocol
+from ocpe_disease_models.models.shared.model import STATE_NAMES
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.mathematical
+
+ALL_PHENOTYPE_IDS = (
+    "healthy-reference",
+    "pots-neuropathic",
+    "pots-hyperadrenergic",
+    "pots-hypovolemic",
+    "pots-mixed",
+    "eds-heds-vascular",
+    "eds-heds-mecfs-comorbid",
+    "mecfs-pem",
+    "long-covid-autonomic",
+    "long-covid-exertional",
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("phenotype_id", ALL_PHENOTYPE_IDS)
+def test_complete_supine_state_is_a_fixed_point(phenotype_id):
+    patient = compose_phenotypes([phenotype_id])
+    protocol, _ = load_protocol("resting-baseline")
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    derivative = patient.rhs(0.0, state, protocol)
+    assert np.max(np.abs(derivative)) < 1e-9, (
+        f"{phenotype_id} supine residual: "
+        + ", ".join(
+            f"{name}={value:.3g}"
+            for name, value in zip(STATE_NAMES, derivative, strict=True)
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("phenotype_id", ALL_PHENOTYPE_IDS)
+def test_supine_cardiac_output_and_venous_return_identities(phenotype_id):
+    patient = compose_phenotypes([phenotype_id])
+    protocol, _ = load_protocol("resting-baseline")
+    derived = patient._derived(0.0, patient.initial_state(), protocol)
+    assert derived["cardiac_output"] == pytest.approx(
+        derived["heart_rate"] * derived["stroke_volume"] / 60.0,
+        rel=1e-12,
+    )
+    assert derived["venous_return"] == pytest.approx(
+        derived["cardiac_output"], rel=1e-10
+    )
+    assert derived["systemic_flow"] == pytest.approx(
+        derived["cardiac_output"], rel=1e-10
+    )
+    assert derived["splanchnic_arterial_flow"] == pytest.approx(
+        derived["splanchnic_venous_return"], rel=1e-10
+    )
+    assert derived["lower_limb_arterial_flow"] == pytest.approx(
+        derived["lower_limb_venous_return"], rel=1e-10
+    )

+def test_early_co_and_caudal_pooling_soft_anchors_are_explicit(healthy_tilt_result):
+    result = healthy_tilt_result
+    t = result.time
+    supine = (t >= 100.0) & (t < 120.0)
+    early = (t >= 120.0) & (t <= 150.0)
+    late = t >= 480.0
+    baseline_co = result.outputs["cardiac_output"][supine].mean()
+    early_co = result.outputs["cardiac_output"][early].min()
+    reduction_percent = 100.0 * (baseline_co - early_co) / baseline_co
+    initial_regional = result.states[:4, supine].mean(axis=1)
+    late_regional = result.states[:4, late].mean(axis=1)
+    caudal_accumulation = float((late_regional - initial_regional)[2:].sum())
+    assert 0.0 <= reduction_percent <= 50.0
+    assert 0.0 <= caudal_accumulation <= 1200.0
+    if not 10.0 <= reduction_percent <= 30.0:
+        warnings.warn(
+            f"early CO reduction {reduction_percent:.2f}% is outside the 10-30% soft anchor",
+            UserWarning,
+            stacklevel=1,
+        )
+    if not 300.0 <= caudal_accumulation <= 900.0:
+        warnings.warn(
+            f"caudal accumulation {caudal_accumulation:.1f} mL is outside the 300-900 mL soft anchor",
+            UserWarning,
+            stacklevel=1,
+        )
+
+

+"""VAL-PHYS-SHARED: regional pump, autonomic, and cerebral mechanisms."""

+def _protocol(**inputs: float) -> list[ProtocolSegment]:
+    return [ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=600.0, **inputs)]

+def test_rhythmic_pump_is_an_exact_compartmental_transfer():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    inactive = patient._derived(0.0, state, _protocol(upright=1.0))
+    active = patient._derived(0.0, state, _protocol(upright=1.0, rhythmic_muscle_activity=1.0))
+    pump = active["muscle_pump_flow"]
+    assert pump > 0.0
+    assert active["lower_limb_venous_return"] - inactive["lower_limb_venous_return"] == pytest.approx(pump)
+    rhs_inactive = patient.rhs(0.0, state, _protocol(upright=1.0))
+    rhs_active = patient.rhs(0.0, state, _protocol(upright=1.0, rhythmic_muscle_activity=1.0))
+    assert rhs_active[1] - rhs_inactive[1] == pytest.approx(pump)
+    assert rhs_active[3] - rhs_inactive[3] == pytest.approx(-pump)
+    assert rhs_active[:4].sum() == pytest.approx(0.0, abs=1e-12)
+    assert active["heart_rate"] == inactive["heart_rate"]
+
+
+def test_sustained_contraction_impedes_passive_lower_limb_return():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    # Use a positive passive upright gradient so resistance, not the flow floor,
+    # determines the comparison.
+    state[3] += 200.0
+    relaxed = patient._derived(0.0, state, _protocol(upright=1.0))
+    contracted = patient._derived(
+        0.0, state, _protocol(upright=1.0, sustained_muscle_contraction=1.0)
+    )
+    assert relaxed["lower_limb_venous_return"] > 0.0
+    assert contracted["lower_limb_venous_resistance_effective"] == pytest.approx(
+        4.0 * relaxed["lower_limb_venous_resistance_effective"]
+    )
+    assert contracted["lower_limb_venous_return"] < relaxed["lower_limb_venous_return"]
+    assert contracted["muscle_pump_flow"] == 0.0
+
+
+def test_rhythmic_activity_conserves_volume_and_redistributes_it():
+    inactive = run_phenotype("healthy-reference", "inactive-standing")
+    active = run_phenotype("healthy-reference", "light-rhythmic-activity")
+    assert stressed_volume_drift(inactive) < 1e-6
+    assert stressed_volume_drift(active) < 1e-6
+    assert active.outputs["muscle_pump_flow"][active.time >= 120].min() > 0.0
+    active_late = active.time >= 480
+    inactive_late = inactive.time >= 480
+    assert active.states[3, active_late].mean() < inactive.states[3, inactive_late].mean()
+    assert active.states[1, active_late].mean() > inactive.states[1, inactive_late].mean()
+

+def test_walking_and_sustained_protocols_conserve_volume():

+        assert np.all(np.isfinite(result.states))

+def test_cardiac_sympathetic_vagal_and_vascular_pathways_are_independent():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    protocol = _protocol()
+    baseline = patient._derived(0.0, patient.initial_state(), protocol)
+    cardiac_state = patient.initial_state()
+    cardiac_state[4] = 0.7
+    cardiac = patient._derived(0.0, cardiac_state, protocol)
+    vagal_state = patient.initial_state()
+    vagal_state[6] = 0.3
+    vagal = patient._derived(0.0, vagal_state, protocol)
+    vascular_state = patient.initial_state()
+    vascular_state[5] = 0.7
+    vascular = patient._derived(0.0, vascular_state, protocol)
+    assert cardiac["heart_rate"] > baseline["heart_rate"]
+    assert cardiac["stroke_volume"] > baseline["stroke_volume"]
+    assert vagal["heart_rate"] > baseline["heart_rate"]
+    assert vagal["stroke_volume"] == pytest.approx(baseline["stroke_volume"])
+    assert vascular["heart_rate"] == pytest.approx(baseline["heart_rate"])
+    assert vascular["splanchnic_arterial_resistance_effective"] > baseline[
+        "splanchnic_arterial_resistance_effective"
+    ]
+    assert vascular["lower_limb_arterial_resistance_effective"] > baseline[
+        "lower_limb_arterial_resistance_effective"
+    ]
+

+def test_vagal_state_responds_faster_than_cardiac_sympathetic_state():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    protocol, _ = load_protocol("head-up-tilt")
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    derivative = patient.rhs(121.0, state, protocol)
+    target = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-10.0))
+    assert derivative[4] == pytest.approx(
+        (target - 0.5) / patient.parameters.cardiac_sympathetic_time_constant
+    )
+    assert derivative[5] == pytest.approx(
+        (target - 0.5) / patient.parameters.vascular_sympathetic_time_constant
+    )
+    assert derivative[6] == pytest.approx(
+        (1.0 - target - 0.5) / patient.parameters.vagal_time_constant
+    )
+

+def test_cerebral_proxy_uses_head_pressure_and_obeys_curve_invariants():
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    p = patient.parameters
+    upright = _protocol(upright=1.0)
+    # Zero CPP gives zero target despite nonzero systemic arterial pressure.
+    state[0] = p.arterial_compliance * (
+        p.head_hydrostatic_pressure_offset + state[1] / p.central_venous_compliance
+    )
+    derived = patient._derived(0.0, state, upright)
+    assert derived["baroreflex_pressure"] == pytest.approx(
+        derived["arterial_pressure"] - p.head_hydrostatic_pressure_offset
+    )
+    assert derived["cerebral_perfusion_pressure"] == 0.0
+    assert derived["cerebral_pressure_target"] == 0.0
+    # CPP at the reference pressure maps exactly to one.
+    state = patient.initial_state()
+    state[0] = p.arterial_compliance * (
+        p.head_hydrostatic_pressure_offset
+        + state[1] / p.central_venous_compliance
+        + p.cerebral_reference_perfusion_pressure
+    )
+    assert patient._derived(0.0, state, upright)["cerebral_pressure_target"] == pytest.approx(1.0)
+    # The bounded high-pressure asymptote is 1/(1-s), not an unbounded index.
+    state[0] *= 20.0
+    high = patient._derived(0.0, state, upright)["cerebral_pressure_target"]
+    assert 1.0 < high < 1.25
+

+        patient.rhs(0.0, state, _protocol())

+                0.0,
+                result.outputs["baroreflex_pressure"]
+                - result.outputs["central_venous_pressure"],

diff --git a/tests/unit/test_declarative_executable_consistency.py b/tests/unit/test_declarative_executable_consistency.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..42bed8558b21d48ac16c26f7bb56fcc3af6f6e90

+"""Consistency checks between the declarative OCPE model and the executable.
+
+The declarative model in ``ocpe/packages/disease-models/models.yaml`` carries
+per-symbol ``x-executable-state`` / ``x-executable-parameter`` /
+``x-executable-input`` / ``x-executable-output`` bindings. These tests verify
+that the bindings are exact, bijective and numerically faithful to the
+executable reference implementation
+(``ocpe_disease_models.models.shared.model``), so the declarative and
+executable forms cannot silently drift apart.
+"""
+# ruff: noqa: E402  (sys.path bootstrap for the src layout precedes imports)
+
+import sys
+from dataclasses import asdict, fields
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+SRC = REPO_ROOT / "src"
+if str(SRC) not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(SRC))
+
+from ocpe_disease_models.interfaces.observation_mapping.mapping import (  # noqa: E402
+    QUANTITY_SPECS,
+    SIMULATOR_OUTPUT_ALIASES,
+)
+from ocpe_disease_models.interfaces.ocpe_adapter import MODEL_CURIE, load_adapter  # noqa: E402
+from ocpe_disease_models.models.shared.model import (  # noqa: E402
+    STATE_NAMES,
+    ComputationalPatient,
+    ModelParameters,
+    ProtocolSegment,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.software
+
+# Dynamic states that are declared with role "output" (not "state") because
+# they are also exchanged quantities with registered OCPE semantics.
+OUTPUT_ROLE_STATES = {"pem_severity", "cerebral_flow_index"}
+
+PROTOCOL_INPUT_FIELDS = {"upright", "exertion", "rhythmic_muscle_activity", "sustained_muscle_contraction"}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def adapter():
+    return load_adapter()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def symbols(adapter):
+    return adapter.model(MODEL_CURIE).data["symbols"]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def equations(adapter):
+    return adapter.model(MODEL_CURIE).data["equations"]
+
+
+def _bound(symbols, key):
+    """Map of executable name -> symbol declaration for one binding kind."""
+    out = {}
+    for s in symbols:
+        name = s.get(key)
+        if name is not None:
+            assert name not in out, f"duplicate {key} binding {name!r}"
+            out[name] = s
+    return out
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------- parameters
+def test_every_executable_parameter_declared_with_matching_nominal(symbols):
+    declared = _bound(symbols, "x-executable-parameter")
+    defaults = asdict(ModelParameters())
+    # Exact bijection: no undeclared field, no dangling binding.
+    assert set(declared) == set(defaults)
+    for name, sym in declared.items():
+        assert sym["role"] == "parameter", f"{name}: bound symbol {sym['symbol']!r} is not a parameter"
+        assert "nominal_value" in sym, f"{name}: no nominal_value declared"
+        assert sym["nominal_value"] == defaults[name], (
+            f"{name}: declared nominal {sym['nominal_value']!r} != executable default {defaults[name]!r}"
+        )
+
+
+def test_declared_parameter_ranges_cover_executable_defaults(symbols):
+    defaults = asdict(ModelParameters())
+    declared = _bound(symbols, "x-executable-parameter")
+    for name, sym in declared.items():
+        rng = sym.get("value_range") or {}
+        value = defaults[name]
+        if "min" in rng:
+            assert rng["min"] <= value, f"{name}: default {value} below declared min {rng['min']}"
+        if "max" in rng:
+            assert value <= rng["max"], f"{name}: default {value} above declared max {rng['max']}"
+
+
+def test_executable_accepts_declared_nominal_values():
+    # The executable's own parameter validation must accept a patient built
+    # from exactly the declared nominal values.
+    declared_defaults = asdict(ModelParameters())
+    patient = ComputationalPatient(ModelParameters.from_mapping(declared_defaults))
+    assert patient.parameters == ModelParameters()
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------- states
+def test_every_executable_state_declared(symbols, equations):
+    declared = _bound(symbols, "x-executable-state")
+    assert set(declared) == set(STATE_NAMES)
+    assert len(STATE_NAMES) == 11
+    for name, sym in declared.items():
+        expected_role = "output" if name in OUTPUT_ROLE_STATES else "state"
+        assert sym["role"] == expected_role, (
+            f"{name}: bound symbol {sym['symbol']!r} has role {sym['role']!r}, expected {expected_role!r}"
+        )
+    # One differential equation per dynamic state, nothing else integrated.
+    differential = [eq for eq in equations if eq.get("form") == "differential"]
+    diff_outputs = [out for eq in differential for out in eq["outputs"]]
+    state_symbols = {declared[name]["symbol"] for name in STATE_NAMES}
+    assert len(differential) == len(STATE_NAMES)
+    assert set(diff_outputs) == state_symbols
+
+
+def test_state_nominals_match_executable_initial_state(symbols):
+    declared = _bound(symbols, "x-executable-state")
+    y0 = ComputationalPatient().initial_state()
+    for index, name in enumerate(STATE_NAMES):
+        nominal = declared[name].get("nominal_value")
+        assert nominal is not None, f"{name}: no nominal_value declared"
+        assert nominal == pytest.approx(float(y0[index]), rel=1e-9), (
+            f"{name}: declared nominal {nominal} != executable initial state {y0[index]}"
+        )
+
+
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------- inputs
+def test_protocol_inputs_declared(symbols):
+    declared = _bound(symbols, "x-executable-input")
+    assert set(declared) == PROTOCOL_INPUT_FIELDS
+    segment_fields = {f.name for f in fields(ProtocolSegment)}
+    assert PROTOCOL_INPUT_FIELDS <= segment_fields
+    for sym in declared.values():
+        assert sym["role"] == "input"
+        rng = sym.get("value_range") or {}
+        # ProtocolSegment.validate enforces normalized [0, 1] inputs.
+        assert rng.get("min") == 0.0 and rng.get("max") == 1.0
+
+
+# -------------------------------------------------------------------- outputs
+def test_mapped_quantities_match_declared_outputs(symbols):
+    """Every observation-mapping entry resolves to a declared output symbol
+    whose ``represents`` and ``unit`` agree with the mapping."""
+    by_symbol = {s["symbol"]: s for s in symbols}
+    for spec in QUANTITY_SPECS.values():
+        sym = by_symbol.get(spec.symbol)
+        assert sym is not None, f"mapping symbol {spec.symbol!r} not declared"
+        assert sym["role"] == "output"
+        assert sym.get("represents") == spec.curie
+        assert sym.get("unit") == spec.unit
+    for alias, canonical in SIMULATOR_OUTPUT_ALIASES.items():
+        assert canonical in QUANTITY_SPECS, f"dangling alias {alias!r} -> {canonical!r}"
+
+
+def test_declared_output_bindings_exist_in_simulation(symbols):
+    """Every symbol bound to an executable output is actually produced by a
+    real (short, deterministic) simulation run."""
+    declared = _bound(symbols, "x-executable-output")
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    result = patient.simulate([ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0)])
+    missing = set(declared) - set(result.outputs)
+    assert not missing, f"bound outputs not produced by the executable: {sorted(missing)}"
+    for name in declared:
+        assert np.all(np.isfinite(result.outputs[name])), f"output {name!r} not finite"
+
+
+def test_declared_nominals_reproduce_executable_operating_point(symbols):
+    """The declared nominal operating point matches the executable's resting
+    initial condition numerically (not just structurally)."""
+    declared_params = _bound(symbols, "x-executable-parameter")
+    nominal = {name: s["nominal_value"] for name, s in declared_params.items()}
+    patient = ComputationalPatient()
+    y0 = patient.initial_state()
+    derived = patient._derived(0.0, y0, [ProtocolSegment(start=0.0, end=10.0)])
+    # Resting heart rate equals the declared resting heart rate.
+    assert derived["heart_rate"] == pytest.approx(nominal["heart_rate_rest"])
+    # Arterial pressure follows the declared linear compartment law.
+    assert derived["arterial_pressure"] == pytest.approx(
+        nominal["arterial_volume_initial"] / nominal["arterial_compliance"]
+    )
+    # Cerebral flow index starts at its declared normalized nominal.
+    assert y0[STATE_NAMES.index("cerebral_flow_index")] == pytest.approx(1.0)
+    # Metabolic capacity starts at the declared baseline.
+    assert derived["metabolic_capacity"] == pytest.approx(nominal["baseline_metabolic_capacity"])
